business_summary: Guangdong Guanghua Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. produces and sells electronic chemicals, chemical reagents, and new energy materials in China and internationally. The company offers copper nitrate, copper carbonate basic, cupric pyrophosphate, copper(II) oxide, copper chloride, copper sulfate pentahydrate, nickel carbonate basic, nickel(II) acetate, nickel(II) chloride hexahydrat, nickel sulfamate solution, nickel sulfate hexahydrate, tin(II) sulfate, sodium stannate trihydrate, potassium stannate trihydrate, tin(II) chloride dihydrate, tin(II) methanesulfonate solution, cobalt sulfamate solution, cobalt sulfate, cobalt acetate, cobalt nitrate, cobalt chloride, and potassium pyrophosphate; and plating additives, such as Cu7 and Cu6 brightener; RSBNip10 additive; RBNiP7 brightener; RBNiP6, BNiP6, and JHD-201 additive; 3461D additive; and 3471 additive. It also provides nickel sulfate, manganese(II) sulfate monohydrate, cobalt sulfate, ternary precursor, lithium iron phosphate, lithium manganese iron phosphate, and ironic phosphate; PCB solutions; elemental class, oxide/peroxidate, inorganic acid, etc.; salts of organic acids, hydrocarbon/substituted hydrocarbons, alcohol/phenol/ether/ketone, nitrile/amine/urea, etc.; biochemical reagent, chromatographic reagent, pH and redox indicator, photochemistry and electrochemical analysis reagent, etc.; and other specialty chemicals. It serves electronic information, energy, automotive, medical and health industries, internet, PCB, energy materials, auto parts, photovoltaic, electronic components, medicine, chemical, bathroom hardware, R&D, and e-commerce industries. The company was formerly known as Shantou Guanghua Chemical Factory Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong Guanghua Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. in 2010. Guangdong Guanghua Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Shantou, China.
